purpose: Teach: グローバリゼーション/投信/空母/プレーオフ/有線/セメント/プランニング/農水省
target_vocab: グローバリゼーション

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究者もグローバリゼーションの中で生きろ
lines.en: Ren — researchers have to live and work within globalization too.
lines.style: Measured directive. Clean attack on the name. Philosophical weight behind the instruction, not harsh. Settles into a pause at the end, letting the idea land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学生向け投信教育も意義あります
lines.en: Yes. And I think investor education for students has real value.
lines.style: Respectful, engaged response. Slight hesitation before building into the second thought — he's thinking as he speaks. Quiet conviction underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究所を空母のように位置付けろ
lines.en: Ren — think of the research institute as a carrier ship. Position it that way.
lines.style: Sharp metaphor delivered with authority. Crisp attack on the image. Expects understanding. No padding — the instruction is clear and weighted.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会のプレーオフ的トーナメントに勝ち抜きます
lines.en: I understand. I'll push through the conference tournament circuit — treat it like playoffs.
lines.style: Determined, forward-leaning. He's catching the military metaphor and running with it. Faster pace than before, energized by the framework.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、有線インターネットの実験環境を整えろ
lines.en: Ren — set up the wired internet infrastructure for your experiments. Do it now.
lines.style: Imperative but not unkind. Direct command rhythm. The 'now' implied in the tone, not the words. Practical urgency underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。セメント素材の研究も視野に入れます
lines.en: Understood. I'll also look into cement material research as part of that framework.
lines.style: Attentive and methodical. Processing the direction, finding where his research intersects. Calm, slightly slower — he's taking notes mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究プランニングを年初に固めろ
lines.en: Ren — lock down your research plan before the year starts. Finalize it.
lines.style: Firm closing instruction. Weight on 'before the year starts' — a deadline, not a suggestion. Expectation of execution clear in the cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。農水省の研究助成にも応募します
lines.en: Yes. I'll apply for MAFF research grants as well.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Respectful but ending the exchange. He's integrated the feedback already — moving to action. Small, satisfied note at the end.
